variants.headline: Looking back: party leader faces a public scandal
variants.sub: A party leader is the subject of a newly revealed scandal.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: A scandal concerning a party leader had come to light in {colony}.

Workers know the difference between being held responsible and being made the subject of gossip. Political leaders should face a serious standard, with fair treatment included in it. Labour's concern is public trust and the use of authority, not the pleasure of seeing a prominent name embarrassed.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

In our judgment, {target} does not deserve confidence in this matter. Political trust requires a demanding standard, and the scandal is an appropriate occasion for a distinctly critical assessment.
